goal: ASP.NET Identity review: password policy, lockout, token lifetimes and account recovery.
use: ASP.NET Identity review: password policy, lockout, token lifetimes and account recovery. Use when the application uses ASP.NET Identity for sign-in.

steps.note: Check the password policy. Length and checks match current guidance.
Check lockout. Failed attempts lock the account for a set period.
Check tokens. Confirmation and reset tokens expire quickly and are single-use.
Check recovery. The recovery flow does not reveal whether an account exists.
Report. Each setting with file and line, the problem and the fix.
